items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: I wish I’d met him. Now that’s the guy I wish I’d met.

ctx.x: Clark Terry used to tell me. I’d say, “Who did you like?” He says Joe Wilder and of course Snooky. And then he mentioned Cadillac Williams. And I said, “Who’s Cadillac Williams?” I said, “Cadillac Williams?” I go — he said, “You should check out Cadillac Williams. He played with Duke Ellington’s band.” So I bought this five volume set of Duke Ellington records. I’m trying to think of the name of the tune, I think it’s called “Brown Betty” if I remember right. Sounds like Clark Terry. I think it was his mentor…

items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: we backed up Joe Wilder on a little tour. “Gentleman of Jazz” I used to call him.

ctx.x: We connected through an Arts In Education program and we ended up doing some school concerts with a program that I worked with in Central New York, and we backed up Joe Wilder on a little tour.
“Gentleman of Jazz” I used to call him.
I’m telling you he is one of my favorite people in the whole world.
